# BCGov Crow - v0.8.1

## Release type

Patch release extending the existing security review and remediation skills.

## Summary

This release adds optional, consent-gated publication of validated security
findings to GitHub Advanced Security and application ticketing systems. It
also lets the existing remediation agent fix selected security tickets or all
open tickets carrying the `crow-security` label.

## Highlights

- GitHub-hosted applications can publish validated findings to GHAS as SARIF
  2.1.0 through the GitHub MCP server.
- Every application can route findings to its configured ticketing system, and
  GitHub-hosted applications can use GHAS and ticketing together.
- Security tickets use the same canonical SARIF result as GHAS and always
  carry the exact `crow-security` label.
- Ticketing destinations and issue-routing preferences can be discovered from
  or, with separate user consent, remembered in `crow.config`.
- Remediation can target user-selected security tickets or all open labeled
  tickets while preserving source verification and separate ticket-close
  approval.

## Changes

- Added a shared security-issue publication contract covering per-application
  destination discovery, explicit consent, deduplication, read-back
  verification, partial failures, and public-safe configuration memory.
- Added deterministic PowerShell conversion of validated findings into GHAS
  SARIF and matching ticket payloads, including stable fingerprints and
  cross-destination equality checks.
- Extended the security review agent with optional GHAS and ticketing
  publication after report finalization.
- Extended the security remediation agent with selected-ticket and
  all-open-ticket modes for the exact `crow-security` label.
- Updated project-context guidance and package documentation for security issue
  routing.

## Validation

- Crow asset validation: passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
- Package dry run: passed.
- Archive inspection: passed; the security publication module and converter
  scripts are included, and local evidence and scanner state are excluded.
- Additional checks: security issue conversion tests and Crow config tests
  passed; the SonarQube quality gate passed.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.8.1 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.8.1.zip --global --target copilot
```
